label: Baseline: an ordinary recorded script, and the runner with its heal ladder off, on the headline's 42 held-out UI-change cases (Caravela mock portal). Baseline arms make no model calls.

script.label: Recorded script: the Playwright export of the same compiled v1 skill, run as-is
script.method: the Playwright TypeScript export of the same compiled v1 skill (`exportPlaywright` in packages/skills), run as-is in a fresh browser context per case with Playwright's default 30 s timeouts. Like a recorded script it has no healing, no read-back and no approval gate. It is more forgiving than a one-selector codegen recording: each step tries its stored selectors in rank order (test id, role, label, CSS, placeholder) and takes the first that matches exactly one element. A value a case leaves out (optional field) is passed as an empty string, since the script fills every field it recorded.

scriptPrimary.label: Recorded script, one selector per step: the same export from the skill cut to each step's primary selector
scriptPrimary.method: the same export generated from the skill with every step cut to its primary (first-ranked) selector, one locator per action as a codegen recording has (test id for most steps; role and name for the two dropdowns and the consent checkbox), run as-is the same way.

noHealNoReadBack.label: Dockhand's runner, heal ladder off, read-back gate off
noHealNoReadBack.method: the same v1 program in Dockhand's runner with each step's primary selector only, no similarity match, no widget swap, no repair models and no questions to the rep; the read-back still runs but does not block the submit.

noHealReadBack.label: Dockhand's runner, heal ladder off, read-back gate on
noHealReadBack.method: as above, with the read-back gate on: every written value is read back and a mismatch stops the run before the submit.

dockhand.label: Dockhand: heal ladder and read-back (section 1, live)
dockhand.method: the live heal-ladder rows of section 1 (evals/results/live/, 2026-10-28), not re-run here.
